name: Apart Laver
beschreibung:
Overview

Apart Laver is a family-run holiday apartment house in Ischgl in the Tyrolean Paznaun. It is located on a traffic-calmed side street right next to the village centre – central and yet quiet. The five bright and spacious apartments are designed for 2 to 5 people; plenty of wood and a good layout characterise the traditional style. Amenities include an electric cooker, oven, dishwasher, filter and capsule coffee machine (Nespresso), cable TV, safe and free Wi-Fi; bed linen, bath and hand towels are provided, and several apartments have a balcony. A parking space is reserved for guests directly at the house, including an e-charging station for electric cars. The hosts are Barbara and Helmut Walser.

History/Background

The names of the apartments tell a personal story: they are named after peaks in Nepal that host Helmut has climbed himself. Island Peak (6,189 m) was his first high mountain, summited on 9 November 2000; Chulu West (6,419 m) followed on 21 November 2001. Muztagh Ata – “Father of the Icebergs” – was the highest mountain he reached (19 August 2006). Further ascents: Cholatse on 10 November 2008 and Ama Dablam on 7 November 2009. Out of his connection to Nepal grew a long-standing social commitment, shown among other things in the support of Nepalhilfe Kulung. The house's partner establishment is Haus Hubertus in Galtür.

Getting There

The address is Grube 1, 6561 Ischgl. From Apart Laver it is around 200 metres to the nearest cable car, 300 metres to the supermarket, 50 metres to the village centre and 250 metres to the Silvretta Center. All three cable cars of Ischgl can be reached on foot in next to no time, and the Silvretta Therme is only about 3 to 5 minutes' walk away. The accommodation is located on a traffic-calmed side street; a parking space is reserved for guests directly at the house, along with an e-charging station. The car can therefore stay parked during your stay.

Tips

Ischgl and the Silvretta invite you to be active all year round. The Silvretta Arena Ischgl/Samnaun, with 239 kilometres of slopes, is one of the most varied ski areas in the Alps; the Silvretta offers diverse opportunities for ski tours, including with mountain and ski guides from the region. Around Ischgl and Galtür, cross-country skiers will find a network of around 100 kilometres of trails – since winter 2026 a fee is charged for their use. The car can stay parked, because shops, restaurants, mountain railways and the thermal spa are all within comfortable walking distance.

Best Time to Travel

According to the price information, the 2026/2027 winter season is divided into the early season from 25 November to 19 December 2026, the high season from 20 December 2026 to 3 April 2027 and the late season from 4 April to 2 May 2027. From 28 March to 2 May 2027, Spring Blanc takes place in Ischgl with sunny skiing fun and open-air events.
